yo adds 1 stitch and makes a hole: yo ya kara dinki 1 ya yi rami
k2tog removes 1, leans right: k2tog yana cire 1, ya karkata dama
ssk removes 1, leans left: ssk yana cire 1, ya karkata zuwa hagu
Net change 0: the scarf stays 47 wide: Canjin gidan yanar gizo 0: gyale yana tsayawa 47 fadi
Lace is fabric with holes placed on purp: Yadin da aka saka shi ne masana'anta tare da ramukan da aka sanya da gangan. Yarn a saman yana ƙara dinki kuma yana yin rami. k2tog ya cire daya ya jingina daidai. ssk ya cire daya ya jingina hagu.
